name: helpwhv
description: HelpWHV — Working Holiday Visa jobs & accommodation in Australia

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const mime={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.json':'application/json; charset=utf-8','.ttf':'font/ttf','.woff2':'font/woff2','.png':'image/png','.svg':'image/svg+xml'};http.createServer((req,res)=>{const u=new URL(req.url,'http://localhost');let f=path.join(process.cwd(),decodeURIComponent(u.pathname==='/'?'/index.html':u.pathname));if(!f.startsWith(process.cwd())){res.writeHead(403);return res.end();}fs.readFile(f,(e,d)=>{if(e){res.writeHead(404);return res.end('Not found');}res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':mime[path.extname(f)]||'application/octet-stream'});res.end(d);});}).listen(4173,'127.0.0.1',()=>console.log('HelpWHV rodando em http://localhost:4173'));"
